results.title: How China’s Himalayan Megadam Could Put South Asia at Risk - The National Interest
results.snippet: None of this proves that China’s Yarlung Tsangpo project will fail. Nor does it establish that construction caused the August disaster in Nepal. But it shows why assessing individual dams’ safety isn’t enough. The entire mountain-river-infrastructure system must be evaluated together. results.title: China launches bond themed around snow leopard conservation at COP17
results.snippet: China has launched a bond project to support biodiversity conservation and sustainable community development in key snow leopard habitats, reports Xinhua.
